Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

multiCollglm 0.4.0

Breaking changes

  • The default definition is now Weissfeld and Sereika (1991) (method = "WS"): the IRLS-weighted design matrix scaled to unit length by column, without centering. (This is what center = FALSE, scale = "unit", the previous default, computed.)
  • method now takes four values: "WS" (default), "MP" (MacKinnon and Puterman, 1989), "X" (new) and "RAW".
  • Removed method = "OZ" (Ozkale, 2021) and method = "MS" (Marx and Smith, 1990). Both centered the data, which drops the intercept from the analysis (so non-essential collinearity cannot be detected) and, for some families such as Gamma with the inverse link, produces an exactly singular matrix. Calling them stops with an explanatory message.
  • Removed the arguments center and scale of condition_number(), bkw_diagnostics() and rvif_diagnostics(). Only method selects the matrix now. Passing center or scale stops with an explanatory message.

New features

  • method = "X": eigenvalues of X_ul’X_ul, the original design matrix scaled to unit length, without the IRLS weights (kappa_X of Lesaffre and Marx, 1993). For a model with intercept it is exactly VisCollin::colldiag(mod, add.intercept = TRUE).
  • method is available in condition_number(), bkw_diagnostics() and rvif_diagnostics() (and their glmnet / cv.glmnet methods), and is reported in the printed output and in the returned object.
  • New article Comparison with VisCollin, run on the package’s real datasets.
  • pkgdown website: “Examples” menu with links to every example, an examples overview article, and a GitHub Actions workflow that builds and publishes the site to the gh-pages branch.

Other changes

  • The multiColl package is no longer used: method = "MP" and ml_collinearity() are computed natively. multiColl has been removed from Suggests; VisCollin has been added (used only by the comparison article and one test).
  • A zero eigenvalue is now detected with a numerical-rank tolerance (max(eigenvalue) * p * .Machine$double.eps), so a perfectly collinear design gives Inf and a warning rather than an arbitrary huge number.
  • The reproduction articles use the four methods; the Nitrogen article shows, with base R code, why centering makes the weighted matrix singular for the Gamma family with inverse link.
  • Tests rewritten: each method against its manual definition, Table 1 of the manuscript on the packaged datasets, equivalence with VisCollin::colldiag().

multiCollglm 0.3.0

  • Initial documented version: condition_number() with five definitions ("RAW", "MP", "MS", "WS", "OZ"), bkw_diagnostics(), rvif_diagnostics(), ml_collinearity(), glmnet / cv.glmnet methods, vignette and pkgdown articles.
